name: NA48/2
summary: NA48/2 operated in the CERN SPS North Area. The collaboration used data from this historical kaon experiment for an original dark-photon analysis.
detection_principle: A π⁰→γe⁺e⁻ sample from charged-kaon decays is searched for narrow π⁰→γA′, A′→e⁺e⁻ peaks in the electron-pair invariant-mass spectrum.

results.summary: No dark-photon signal; upper limits on photon–dark-photon mixing were obtained.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
